## 2. Scope

This Privacy Policy applies to:
- **What's for Dinner?** mobile applications (iOS, Android)
- **What's for Dinner?** web application (PWA)
- Our website (https://whats-for-dinner.ca)

This Privacy Policy does not apply to:

## 3. Information We Collect

### 3.1 Personal Information

We collect the following personal information:

#### Account Information
- **Name**: Your full name (for account creation)
- **Email Address**: Your email address (for account creation, login, communications)
- **Password**: Encrypted password (hashed, never stored in plain text)

#### Meal Planning Data
- **Meal Plans**: Your meal plans, preferences, dietary restrictions
- **Pantry Information**: Ingredients you have (pantry management)
- **Recipe Preferences**: Recipes you've saved, rated, or favorited
- **Cooking History**: Meals you've planned or cooked

#### Usage Data (Opt-In Only)
- **App Usage**: How you use the app (features used, time spent)
- **Device Information**: Device type, operating system, app version
- **Analytics**: Anonymized usage statistics (only if you opt-in)

**Note**: Analytics are **opt-in only**. We do not collect usage data without your explicit consent.

### 3.2 Payment Information

We use **Stripe** for payment processing. We do not store your credit card information. Payment data is handled by Stripe in accordance with their privacy policy.

**Collected**: Subscription status, payment history, billing address (if provided)

### 3.3 Grocery Store Integration

When you use grocery store integration (Loblaws, Metro, Sobeys):
- **Store Preferences**: Your preferred grocery stores
- **Shopping Lists**: Grocery lists generated from meal plans
- **Store Data**: Product information, pricing (from grocery store APIs)

**Note**: We do not share your personal information with grocery stores. Grocery store APIs may collect their own data in accordance with their privacy policies.

---

## 4. How We Use Your Information

### 4.1 Purpose Limitation

We use your personal information only for the following purposes:

1. **App Functionality**: To provide meal planning services, grocery list generation, recipe suggestions
2. **Account Management**: To create and manage your account, authenticate logins
3. **Communications**: To send you important updates, support responses (with your consent)
4. **Improvement**: To improve our app, features, and services (with your consent, opt-in analytics)
5. **Legal Compliance**: To comply with legal obligations, enforce our terms of service

### 4.2 Consent

We obtain your consent before collecting, using, or disclosing your personal information:

- **Express Consent**: You provide consent when you create an account, opt-in to analytics
- **Implied Consent**: Consent is implied for essential app functionality (meal planning, account management)
- **Withdrawal of Consent**: You can withdraw consent at any time (see Section 8)

---

## 5. How We Share Your Information

### 5.1 We Do Not Sell Your Data

**We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal information to third parties.**

### 5.2 Service Providers

We may share your information with trusted service providers who assist us in operating our app:

- **Supabase**: Database, authentication, storage (Canadian data residency)
- **Stripe**: Payment processing (payment data only)
- **Analytics Providers**: Opt-in analytics (anonymized data only)

**Requirements**: All service providers are contractually obligated to protect your information and use it only for the purposes we specify.

### 5.3 Legal Requirements

We may disclose your information if required by law:
- Court orders, subpoenas, legal processes
- Law enforcement requests
- Regulatory compliance (PIPEDA, CASL)

### 5.4 Business Transfers

In the event of a merger, acquisition, or sale of assets, your information may be transferred to the acquiring entity (with notice to you).

---

## 6. Data Storage & Security

### 6.1 Data Residency

**Your personal information is stored in Canada**. We use Supabase's Canadian data centers (Montreal or Toronto) to ensure Canadian data residency.

**Exception**: Payment processing may involve US-based services (Stripe), but payment data is handled in accordance with Stripe's privacy policy and PCI-DSS compliance.

### 6.2 Security Measures

We implement security measures to protect your information:

- **Encryption**: Data encrypted in transit (HTTPS) and at rest
- **Access Control**: Role-based access control (RBAC), limited access to personal information
- **Password Security**: Passwords hashed using bcrypt (never stored in plain text)
- **Regular Audits**: Security audits, vulnerability assessments

**Note**: No method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure. We cannot guarantee absolute security.

---

## 7. Data Retention

### 7.1 Retention Period

We retain your personal information for as long as necessary to provide our services:

- **Active Accounts**: Data retained while your account is active
- **Inactive Accounts**: Data retained for 2 years after last activity, then deleted
- **Deleted Accounts**: Data deleted within 30 days of account deletion request

### 7.2 Deletion

You can request deletion of your account and data at any time (see Section 8).

---

## 8. Your Rights (PIPEDA)

Under PIPEDA, you have the following rights:

### 8.1 Access

You have the right to access your personal information:
- **Request**: Email privacy@whats-for-dinner.ca
- **Response**: We will provide your data within 30 days (free of charge)

### 8.2 Correction

You have the right to correct inaccurate information:
- **Request**: Update your information in-app or email privacy@whats-for-dinner.ca
- **Response**: We will correct inaccurate information promptly

### 8.3 Deletion

You have the right to request deletion of your information:
- **Request**: Delete your account in-app or email privacy@whats-for-dinner.ca
- **Response**: We will delete your data within 30 days (except where retention is required by law)

### 8.4 Withdrawal of Consent

You can withdraw consent at any time:
- **Analytics**: Opt-out in app settings
- **Marketing Emails**: Unsubscribe link in emails (CASL-compliant)
- **Account**: Delete your account to withdraw all consent

### 8.5 Complaints

If you believe we have violated your privacy rights, you can file a complaint:
- **Our Office**: privacy@whats-for-dinner.ca
- **Privacy Commissioner of Canada**: https://www.priv.gc.ca/en/

---

## 9. Children's Privacy

**What's for Dinner?** is not intended for children under 13 years of age. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

If you believe we have collected information from a child under 13, please contact us at privacy@whats-for-dinner.ca, and we will delete the information promptly.

## 10. International Transfers

**Your data is stored in Canada**. We do not transfer your personal information outside Canada, except:

- **Payment Processing**: Stripe may process payment data in the US (PCI-DSS compliant)
- **Analytics**: Opt-in analytics may involve US-based services (anonymized data only)

**Safeguards**: We ensure adequate safeguards are in place for any international transfers.

## 11. Cookies & Tracking

### 11.1 Cookies

We use cookies and similar technologies for:

- **Analytics** (Opt-In Only): Usage statistics, performance monitoring

### 11.2 Tracking

We do not use third-party tracking cookies or advertising trackers.

**Opt-Out**: You can disable cookies in your browser settings, but this may affect app functionality.
